Assam for the State.

The petitioner, namely, Seher Ali @ Saher Ali, has filed this application under Section 438 Cr.P.C.
seeking pre-arrest bail apprehending his arrest in Kokrajhar P.S. Case No. 143/2023 registered under Sections 448/ 376(3)/511 IPC read with Section 8/18 of POCSO Act.

Page No.# 2/2 During the deliberation of the matter, Ms. M Khatun, learned counsel for the petitioner placed before the Court that police after investigating the matter submitted the charge-sheet in said Kokrajhar P.S. Case No. 143/2023, in which the petitioner is an FIR named accused.
